title: Account and security
profile.verify_sent: A verification link was sent to your e-mail
profile.edit_hint: Your display name. The e-mail cannot be changed here.
profile.email_hint: The e-mail address cannot be changed in the app or the panel.
totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.description: Use an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, …) for sign-in and sensitive actions.
totp.setup_scan_hint: If the authenticator is on another device, scan the QR code; if it is on this phone, open it in the app or type the key.
totp.open_app_failed: No authenticator app found on this phone. Type the key instead.
totp.recovery_hint: Keep these codes somewhere safe. If you lose your device, each code works once.
totp.disable_description: Enter a current authenticator code or a recovery code to turn 2FA off.
passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.description: Device passkeys registered for passwordless sign-in.
passkey.empty_body: You can add a passkey in the web panel under Profile → Security.
passkey.delete_description: "{{name}}" will be removed from your account. You can add it again later.
passkey.native_note: Adding a passkey and signing in with one are not supported in the app yet; use the web panel. Here you can see and remove registered passkeys.
sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices signed in to your account right now.
sessions.empty_body: Sign in again to see this device.
sessions.revoke_description: That device will have to sign in again.
sessions.revoke_others_description: Every session except this device ends.
preferences.title: Notification preferences
preferences.description: Choose how we keep you informed.
preferences.email_hint: Security e-mails (password reset) are always sent.
preferences.inapp_hint: The notification center in the app and the panel.
preferences.realtime_hint: Notifications show up instantly while the panel is open.
preferences.push_hint: Phone and browser notifications. The phone also needs notification permission.
delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Deleting your account signs you out everywhere and blocks sign-in. Companies keep rental, contract and accounting records for legal retention; they show "Deleted user" instead of your name.
delete.restore_window: Within 30 days you can restore the account with the link in the e-mail; after that your account details are erased for good.
delete.code_intro: We will send a 6-digit code to {{email}} to confirm. You can also confirm with your password.
delete.code_sent: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
delete.confirm_body: You will be signed out everywhere. You can restore it within 30 days with the link in the e-mail.
delete.success: Your account is closed. It will be erased for good in 30 days.
delete.invalid_code: The code is wrong or expired.
delete.step_up_cancelled: Confirm your identity to delete the account.
delete.last_owner_body: You are the only owner of these companies. Before deleting your account, hand ownership to another team member in the web panel:
step_up.title: Confirm it's you
step_up.description: This action needs you to confirm your identity again.
step_up.no_methods: No verification method is available for your account. Try the web panel.
step_up.passkey_note: Passkey verification is web panel only for now.
